name: psrvhitfunc 52 - warcry debuff on enemies, stats from owner
description: Replaces the body of missile hit function 52 with an enemy-targeting warcry applier whose stat formulas are evaluated against the missile owner instead of the unit hit. 3.3 rebuild of the 2.4 'SrvHit21 enemy debuff clone of SrvHit18' body.

patches.description: Overwrite sub_140461690 (psrvhitfunc table slot 52, RVA 2391030 + 52*8) with: pOwner = SUNIT_GetOwner(490300); bail 1 if none; skip if SUNIT_AreUnitsAligned(48E4D0) is true (inverted vs srvhit18, so allies and the caster are skipped); then SKILLS_ApplyWarcryStats(566640)(pGame, pTarget, pOwner, MISSILE_GetSkill(3BC450), MISSILE_GetLevel(3BB470)). State comes from the skill's aurastate (+160); auralencalc and aurastat1-6/aurastatcalc1-6 are evaluated on the OWNER. Original 13-byte prologue is preserved so the existing .pdata unwind record stays valid; the remaining 299 bytes of the old 8-direction sub-missile spawner are left in place as unreachable dead code.
